extraction.name: Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS)
extraction.description: A large multilingual read-speech corpus for speech research derived from LibriVox audiobooks. It contains 8 languages, including about 44.5K hours of English and about 6K hours across 7 other languages, and is intended to support ASR and TTS research.
extraction.creator: Vineel Pratap, Qiantong Xu, Anuroop Sriram, Gabriel Synnaeve, Ronan Collobert
extraction.inLanguage: en, de, nl, es, fr, pt, it, pl
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by downloading LibriVox audiobooks in selected languages, downsampling the audio, segmenting long files into 10–20 second clips using trained acoustic models, generating pseudo-labels, and retrieving original transcripts by matching pseudo-labels to available book transcripts.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Read audiobook audio from LibriVox, mostly based on Project Gutenberg text data; language model source text came from Project Gutenberg books.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Automatic audio segmentation used trained acoustic models with TDS convolutions, ASG loss, and wav2letter@anywhere for streaming inference.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is biased toward read audiobook speech from public-domain sources and is heavily imbalanced across languages, with much more English data than other languages.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited to read-speech audiobooks rather than broader speech domains, and there are vocabulary coverage issues for some languages, especially Polish with a high OOV rate.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The authors state that the dataset is intended to expand multilingual ASR and TTS research by being freely available.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Suitable for speech research, especially ASR and TTS; includes train, development, and test splits, limited-supervision train sets, released language-model training data and pre-built language models, and baseline ASR models.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is planned for free public release, along with language-model training data and pre-built language models; no update schedule, maintainers, or deprecation policy are specified.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Audio data augmentation during model training using SpecAugment with two frequency masks and ten time masks; time warping was not used.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Downloaded LibriVox audiobooks were downsampled from 48kHz to 16kHz, segmented into 10–20 second utterances using acoustic-model-based inference and timestamps, and books were filtered to avoid overlap with development and test sets by removing title-near-duplicates and books sharing more than 1% of indexed 5-grams.

description.evidence: This paper introduces Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS) dataset, a large multilingual corpus suitable for speech research. The dataset is derived from read audiobooks from LibriVox and consists of 8 languages, including about 44.5K hours of English and a total of about 6K hours for other languages.
